name: Duet Knot
description: Tie a knot on each of a foe's hands in one beat so the pair closes together.

name: Mate Guard
description: Guard with one arm and tie the other to an ally's so the two guards overlap.

name: Mate Sense
description: Feel the second end of a pair-tie to know where its partner stands.

name: Pair Clasp
description: Hold two foes on a single pair-tie so they pull against one another.

name: Return Pair
description: Send a blow caught on the first tie out through the second to strike back.

name: Shared Mantle
description: Spread one mantle of qi over the user and an ally so both draw on the same reserve.

name: Doubled Fetter
description: Close two fetters on one strong foe so that breaking one only tightens the other.

name: Twin Stroke
description: Strike the foe in front while the second tie pulls the foe's back foot from behind.

name: Bound Pair
description: Bind two foes into a pair and make whatever harm either deals fall on the other.

name: Pair Reckoning
description: The school's closing move that ties foe to foe and drops the weight of the bond on both at once.

name: Eye Thread
description: Send a thread to a foe's line of sight and feel where the foe is looking.

name: Perch Lash
description: Lash a cord from a high perch round a foe's weapon arm.

name: Cupped Brace
description: Brace in a hollow of qi that carries the user's weight.

name: Stooping Glide
description: Stoop along a tether from a height and land beside a foe in a flash.

name: Talon Pin
description: Pin a foe's two ankles with a pair of talon hooks of qi.

name: Drift Net
description: Spread a drifting net of qi that settles over a quick foe and slows it.

name: Wing Parry
description: Fan cords like feathers and brush aside a thrown blade.

name: Cupped Snare
description: Hollow a snare shaped like a basin that holds whatever foe steps in.

name: Sky Lashing
description: Lash cords down from high over a wide patch and catch every foe below.

name: Dominion Tether
description: Cast a tether on a lone strong foe from a great height and hold the foe motionless.

name: Hawk's Judgment
description: The school's closing stoop of cords that seizes a foe in the air and drives the foe down.

name: Paired Hitch
description: Tie a quick hitch from each hand so two foes at the edge of reach are held at once.

name: Crossed Parry
description: Parry a strike with a cord from each hand crossed in front of the chest.

name: Twin Ear
description: Hear through two lines at once which of two bound foes is lying.

name: Matched Hold
description: Hold twin knots on a foe's two weapon hands for as long as the user breathes steadily.

name: Counter Hitch
description: Hitch a foe's cast cord to the user's own and spoil the cast with a twist.

name: Even Weight
description: Even out the weight borne by two bound allies so neither tires first.

name: Knot Weave
description: Lay a field of paired knots across the ground that close on foes as they cross.

name: Matched Fetters
description: Hold a gathering of foes in fetters tied in pairs so each pulls on a neighbour.

name: Matched Bonds
description: Close paired bonds on a group so each foe is held by one neighbour and holds another.

name: Pairbinder
description: The school's closing move that ties every foe within reach into one court of paired knots.

name: Core Thread
description: Draw a thread from the formed core and tie it round a foe's wrist.

name: Core Veil
description: Gather core qi into a guard that spreads from the chest to the shoulders.

name: Core Sense
description: Feel through the core every bond that reaches the user from afar.

name: Core Tether
description: Hold a tether on a foe with qi taken from the core without strain.

name: Horizon Step
description: Step to the far end of a tether in one bound that reaches the limit of sight.

name: Core Unpicking
description: Draw a binding or curse out of an ally through the core's steady pull.

name: Core Net
description: Cast a net of core-born tethers over a wide field in one beat.

name: Sightline Hold
description: Hold a foe at the limit of sight by a bond that loses no strength with distance.

name: Sky Fetter
description: Close a fetter from the core that holds a powerful foe wherever the user's eye can reach.

name: Horizon Tether
description: The school's closing move that ties a foe to the far horizon and seals the foe's qi to the line.

name: First Vow
description: Speak a first vow to an ally and lend the ally a measure of calm.

name: Gust Hitch
description: Hitch a quick cord to a rising gust and catch a foe's trailing arm.

name: Heel Tether
description: Bind the heels to a line in the ground so a gust cannot lift the user.

name: Sworn Cord
description: Spin a cord sworn to a vow that grows heavier the more the foe resists.

name: Oath Parry
description: Parry a blow with an arm wrapped in a sworn cord that a lesser blade cannot cut.

name: Tight Word
description: Bind a foe's voice so that shouts and calls for aid die in the throat.

name: Vow Easing
description: Ease a harsh sworn binding from an ally until the ally breathes freely.

name: Gust Fetters
description: Lay fetters on the rising wind that close on any foe running before it.

name: Rolling Cinch
description: Roll a wave of cinching cords outward and tighten each as it passes a foe.

name: Wind-Sworn Hold
description: Hold a foe with a bond sworn to the wind so that no shelter can break it.

name: Sworn Tempest
description: The school's closing storm of sworn cords that takes every foe at once and holds each to its oath.

name: Hold Bearing
description: Hold the chosen bearing against a rushing foe with the feet tied to a line.

name: Bearing Loop
description: Loop a cord on the foe's bearing so the foe veers off its course.

name: Bearing Probe
description: Check by touch whether the foe keeps a true bearing.

name: Gust Cinch
description: Cinch a foe's waist with a cord that tightens on every gust.

name: Gust Veer
description: Meet a rush of force with a cord pulled crosswise to push it past the user.

name: Steady Lend
description: Lend an ally the user's own steadiness across a short line until the ally's stance holds.

name: Bearing Net
description: Cast a net along the held bearing so every foe who crosses it is snared.

name: Standing Tether
description: Hold a long line across a charge and slow every foe who strikes against it.

name: Unbent Seizure
description: Seize a foe with a bond that stays straight and level under any struggle.

name: Bearing Oath
description: The school's closing move that ties a foe to the bearing the binder holds and pins the foe there.

name: Bare Cord
description: Cast a plain cord in the open with nothing to hide behind and close it on a foe's hand.

name: Stark Guard
description: Stand in the open behind a guard of qi that wants no wall.

name: Clear Sense
description: Read the intent of a person who stands in plain view by the tension of their bond.

name: Frank Hold
description: Keep a plain unhidden hold on a foe by the oath behind the bond.

name: Frank Parry
description: Parry a blow in plain sight with a cord that makes no feint.

name: Open Vow
description: Speak a vow aloud so allies who hear it stand firmer for it.

name: Roar Net
description: Cast a net of cords that rises and falls with the user's shout and snares each foe it covers.

name: Unsheltered Fetters
description: Hold a foe in fetters that need no cover and do not weaken in the open.

name: Bare Dominion
description: Bind a gathering of foes in plain sight with a bond that needs no corner to anchor in.

name: Open Reckoning
description: The school's closing move that binds every foe by the oath it has spoken in the open.

name: Oathcore Thread
description: Pull a thread of oath-warmed qi from the core and tie it on a foe's wrist.

name: Core Bearing
description: Settle a bearing in the core so the stance cannot be turned from outside.

name: Vow Pulse
description: Send a pulse of sworn qi along a bond into the foe at its end.

name: Core Listen
description: Listen in the core for the tug of every oath that touches the user.

name: Oath Tether
description: Hold a tether on a foe by the strength of an oath drawn from the core.

name: Gust Stride
description: Stride down a tether carried on the wind and arrive far from the starting point.

name: Core Unbinding
description: Unwind a hostile binding from an ally by pulling it into the core and burning it out.

name: Sworn Break
description: Break a foe's own oath-tie in mid cast and watch the technique fall apart.

name: Oathcore Net
description: Cast a net of sworn core qi across a wide field and close it on all within.

name: Far Vow
description: Hold a foe across a great distance by a vow that the wind carries to the target.

name: Oathcore Dominion
description: Lay a bond of oath and core on a mighty foe that no wind can carry away.

name: Whole Oath
description: The school's closing move that binds a foe to a vow and seals the foe's qi until the vow is kept.
